summary: Karat Packaging Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that its Board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.45 per share, payable on May 28, 2026 to holders of record on May 21, 2026. The filing includes a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, capital-return event beyond ordinary course, activist, restructuring, or other special category is present. The filing is a standard current report on an ordinary dividend and warrants classification as None.
